vault.info: The vault stores credentials for API clients and other secrets, encrypted with a master password. It lives outside your context folder, so it never travels with a sync. The format is portable: the same vault opens on another machine, and in other tools that read it.
vault.create.title: Create the vault
vault.create.info: Choose a master password. It is the only way in: there is no recovery, and nobody can reset it for you.
vault.create.placeholder: Pick something long you will remember
vault.create.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
vault.create.warning: Losing this password means losing every secret in the vault.
vault.unlock.title: Unlock the vault
vault.unlock.info: The vault is locked. Enter the master password to let API clients use their stored credentials.
vault.list.title: Stored secrets
vault.list.empty: The vault is empty. Credentials appear here once an API client has one saved.
vault.list.name: Name
vault.list.hint: Values are never shown. Formidable reads them only when a client makes a call.
vault.entry.name: Name
vault.entry.name_hint: Letters, digits, dash, underscore and dot.
vault.confirm.delete_message: Delete "{0}"? The stored value is gone for good, and anything using it stops working.
vault.toast.wrong_password: That master password is not correct.
vault.entry.value_hint_multiline: Stored encrypted, and never shown again once saved. Newlines are kept, so a key or a connection string can go in whole.
vault.password.title: Change master password
vault.password.info: Every secret is re-encrypted under the new password. Nothing is lost, and the vault stays open.
vault.password.warning: Anything else sharing this vault will need the new password too.
vault.auto_lock_hint: The vault locks itself again after {0} minutes without use.
